# About

I am an Associate Professor at [University of Rouen Normandy](https://www.univ-rouen.fr) in the Laboratoire d'Economie Rouen Normandie ([LERN](https://lern.univ-rouen.fr/)).  

I defended my PhD thesis, supervised by [Alain Desdoigts](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=6c8QzJwAAAAJ&hl=fr), in July 2025 at [Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne University](https://www.pantheonsorbonne.fr/).

From 2025 to 2026, I was a Postdoctoral Researcher at [AgroParisTech](https://www.agroparistech.fr) in the Centre for International Research on Environment and Development ([CIRED](https://www.centre-cired.fr)), supervised by [Thierry Brunelle](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=70WNvUcAAAAJ&hl=fr).  

From 2023 to 2025, I was a Teaching Fellow (ATER) in the Department of Economics at [Sciences Po Paris](https://www.sciencespo.fr/fr/).

My research interests are primarily in development and agricultural economics.  

<hr style="border: 2px solid black;">
